callees.name: _load_json_edges
callees.pre_condition: text is a non-empty, non-whitespace-only string containing valid JSON whose top-level object has an 'edges' key whose value is a JSON array of valid edge objects.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of CallEdge objects, one for each element in the 'edges' array, preserving the order of the elements as they appear in the array.
